hotel_name: Miran Hotel & Suites - Mathura Road Faridabad

positive_snippets: Rooms were very spacious and clean. Great value for money. Food taste was amazing must try chilli chicken.

Had my bachelorette here and it turned out to be the perfect place for a private celebration. The ambience was beautiful, rooms were clean and spacious, and the staff was extremely cooperative and professional. Everything was well managed, which made our party stress-free and super fun. Truly an amazing experience and highly recommended for private events!
One of the finest place i have ever visit plus the staff was very friendly … best place to recommend
